public class Main {
    public static int gcd(int a, int b) {
        return b == 0 ? a : gcd(b, a % b);
    }
    
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
        double x = scanner.nextDouble();
        double y = scanner.nextDouble();
        int n = scanner.nextInt();
        
        int a = 0, b = 1;
        double ret = x / y;
        double rett = 0;
        double eps = 1e-15;
        
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            int val1 = (int) Math.floor(ret * i);
            int val2 = (int) Math.ceil(ret * i);
            
            if (Math.abs(ret - (double) val1 / i) + eps < Math.abs(ret - rett)) {
                a = val1;
                b = i;
                rett = (double) val1 / i;
            }
            if (Math.abs(ret - (double) val2 / i) + eps < Math.abs(ret - rett)) {
                a = val2;
                b = i;
                rett = (double) val2 / i;
            }
        }
        
        int g = gcd(a, b);
        System.out.println(a / g + "/" + b / g);
    }
}
